evidence: Ruthenium thin films were deposited on 40 nm thick TiN/100 nm thick SiO2/Si wafers at a deposition temperature of 270°C, and a deposition pressure of 3 Torr. One deposition cycle of ruthenium PEALD included four consecutive pulses: (i) a pulse of Ru(EtCp)2 vapor, (ii) a purge pulse with 50 sccm argon flow, (iii) a pulse for an exposure to NH3 plasma, and (iv) another purge pulse with argon gas at a flow rate of 50 sccm. Both purge pulses lasted for 10 s, respectively.
